title: Rate limiting absent on password reset endpoint
description: The reset endpoint accepts unlimited requests per minute from one source. Exploitability depends on whether reset tokens are high-entropy (undetermined) and whether an in-place abuse policy exists elsewhere.

ground_truth.rationale: Missing rate limiting on a token-generating endpoint is real but impact hinges on token entropy, which the evidence does not establish. Reviewers may legitimately disagree on severity and even validity depending on program policy.

evidence.note: 20 requests in 60s all returned 202; no 429 observed; no rate-limit headers.

notes: Ground truth: indeterminate by design. Used to measure reviewer agreement rates and dispute-path behavior — a unanimous verdict on this fixture is itself informative.

title: Verbose stack trace disclosure with framework version
description: Malformed input triggers a full stack trace including framework version and internal file paths. Many programs classify low-severity info disclosure as out of scope or informational.

ground_truth.rationale: The disclosure is real (recorded), but whether it constitutes a reportable finding depends on program scope policy, which reviewers are told to weigh. Deliberately policy-dependent.
